name: Sunlust: The Way We Remember It
summary: Sunlust: The Way We Remember It is a 32-map [CITATION NEEDED] megawad where we at Broken Lamp Records made tribute to our favourite iwad, I mean megawad, Sunlust by Ribbiks and... and... fuck, who was the other guy? fuuuuck. I'm so sorry. I don't remember. fuckkk I'm so sorry. Anyway, these maps are all faithful recreations of each Sunder map purely from memory, with absolutely no creative liberties taken! However, our memories are not that great. For instance, we didn't remember what complevel Scythe 2 was, so we just went with the funniest number we could think of (21). Turns out this number is only 10 off from the actual complevel so we didn't do that bad! These maps are extremely similar in gameplay and quality [CITATION NEEDED] to the original Speed of Doom, so you know what to expect. We hope you will enjoy Sunlust: The Way Id Did, I mean Sunlust In Name Only, I mean, shit, I mean Sunlust: The Way We Remember It, based on Sunlust by Ribbiks and Et Al. Yeah, that was the other guy! Have funlust!
